request.description: Only `launch` is supported. Lambdapi runs the type-checker in-process; there is no external proof process to attach to.

program.description: Path to the .lp file to type-check. Supports `$ZED_FILE` for the active editor file.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause at the start of every proof so you can step through the tactics.

debug.description: Lambdapi debug-trace flags (e.g. `"u"` for unification, `"iut"` for inference + unification + tactics). Each character enables one logger; output is streamed to the Debug Console. Empty string disables debug tracing.

cwd.description: Working directory the kernel runs in (used for `lambdapi.pkg` resolution). Defaults to the worktree root.
